walk.environment:
Build: the read-only worktree /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/tree at 9eb10528 (git status was clean before and after; the repo was clean too). The app ran from that folder with python -c "from src.api.main import main; main()" through /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/scripts/launch.py, a copy of the re-walk launcher with cwd pointed at rewalk2/tree. The launcher drops the proxy variables, OO_DB_PASSPHRASE and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT, and sets PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1.

Seed: a FRESH full seed (not --mini), with nothing copied from earlier walks, so no briefing_cache.json from an older build was involved. Command: scripts/ui_clickthrough_seed.py into /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/data-enc with OO_DB_PASSPHRASE=walk-pass-2026 and OO_DB_PLAINTEXT unset. It produced 453 articles, 6418 sources, 24 law_documents and 1 wiki_pages row. The database's first 16 bytes are random, not 'SQLite format 3', so it is encrypted at rest. There was no keys/ folder before the first export.

Servers, port 9606, TZ=Europe/Paris (the machine clock is UTC, so local time is measurable):
- Boot 1 (PID 30420) used J1-J6 and the 375 px passes.
- Boot 2 (PID 3775) added HF_HOME=/tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/fake-hf, a copy of the re-checker's synthetic 3-file, 2.9 MB Hugging Face store. It served J7, J8, J-1, J-2, J-3 and J-4.
Both boots had neither passphrase variable set. curl /api/system/lock-state returned {"state":"locked"} each time, and each was unlocked through the real #pw / #btn-unlock form (shots/lock-page-j1.png and lock-page-j7.png). Both servers were stopped by PID.

Airplane mode: I did NOT boot with OO_NO_SCHEDULER=1. The normal boot engaged the kill switch itself, so after each unlock GET /api/system/network returned {"online": false} and #net-plane had fill=currentColor. No POST was needed, and it stayed offline in every stage. No page request left 127.0.0.1 (external_requests is empty in every results file). Row J reaches no consent popup and none appeared, so none was opened or cancelled. The server logs show no 4xx or 5xx apart from my own curl of /api/system/network while the app was locked (503, expected).

Destinations were local folders: the "drive" was /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/drive, reached through Browse… → ⬆ Parent folder → Use this folder. No removable drive exists.

Browser: Chromium /opt/pw-browsers/chromium, headless, args --disable-background-networking --disable-component-update --no-proxy-server, proxy variables unset. Viewports: 1440x950 in en, with live switches through #lang-switch to fr, ar and zh and back, and 375x812 in en and ar.

Everything is under /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/:
- scripts/walk.py (the driver) and scripts/arrow_measure.py
- results/*.json and *.log
- shots/*.png
- J3/J8 listings and command output
- server-1.log and server-2.log

One evidence mishap: a later helper run (drive-fill, which made same-minute exports in drive/ for the picker checks) overwrote results/j4.json and shots/J4-dialog-after-3-en.png. The J4 evidence was rebuilt from the folders on disk into results/j4-step.json. The J4 console output was captured before that, and the stat/sha files J4-first-folder-before.txt and -after.txt are intact.

walk.summary:
Row J passes this walk. J1 to J6 and the 375 px pass all pass. J7 and J8 are not measurable here, because they need the operator's removable drive and the maintainer's word on the reference VM; their sandbox equivalents pass. All four re-walk items are fixed: J-1 (minimum fix), J-2, J-3 and J-4.

Setup: a fresh full seed, encrypted at rest, on build 9eb10528, port 9606. It booted locked twice and was unlocked through the real #pw/#btn-unlock form each time. It stayed in airplane mode throughout (the boot engaged it), and no request left loopback. No consent popup is reachable in this row.

- **Export:** it writes dated local-time folders, with _2 and _3 in the same minute, and never touches an earlier folder. The panel verifies 4 volumes from the first export on, puts articles first and shows exactly two licence lines with no OSM line. BACKUP_SUMMARY.md matches the panel and the read-only volumes.json command. With verify off, the panel reads red 'Not verified'. The dialog is recovered after a reload.
- **Locales:** fr, ar and zh are fully translated through live switches. Paths stay left to right in ar.
- **J-1:** a reload during the corpus phase now leaves oo-export-request.json in the folder. The reopened dialog reads 'Backup incomplete →' with a red 'Incomplete … LLM models' line and a 'Copy the large-data files now' button, and the summary file says INCOMPLETE. The button completes the copy into the same folder. The copy still does not start by itself after a reload; that one-job export is deferred by ruling.
- **J-2 / J-4:** the folder picker keeps the path and the dated names left to right in Arabic, and wraps names at 375 px so the _2 suffix stays visible.
- **J-3:** Arabic uses التكافؤ, المجموعة and وحدات consistently across the export surface. Its completion arrow is ←, pointing at the path. zh uses full-width brackets.

Two incidentals, neither a failure: the J3/J8 step text should mention oo-export-request.json, and the first 'Large data: 0 files copied' progress snapshot.

Everything is under /tmp/claude-0/rewalk2/out/J/. One evidence note: results/j4.json was overwritten by a later helper run, and the J4 evidence was rebuilt from disk into results/j4-step.json.
